[[File:Drall_flashstick-SoF.png|thumb|130px|A Drall flashstick]]
A '''flashstick''' was a small metal baton similar to a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]], developed and used by law enforcement on [[Drall (planet)|Drall]]. When the flashstick made contact with a target, the weapon emitted a powerful and blinding flash capable of blinding a target for hours. This was especially effective to the native [[Drall/Legends|Drall]], who were extraordinarily sensitive to bright light - essentially incapacitating them completely. It was less effective on other [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] that did not possess a sensitivity to light: the subject was blinded, but not incapacitated. The device weighed one kilogram and was widely available.
